title: (RHEA-2020:4917) Red Hat OpenShift Pipelines 1.2 Technology Preview release
portal_summary: Red Hat OpenShift Pipelines 1.2 Technology Preview release - A Cloud-Native Continuous Integration and Delivery solution on OpenShift
portal_synopsis: Red Hat OpenShift Pipelines 1.2 Technology Preview release
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Pipelines|Red Hat OpenShift Pipelines|1.2|x86_64
portal_solution: To know more about Red Hat OpenShift Pipelines and install it, follow the instructions link from the References section.
portal_description:
Red Hat OpenShift Pipelines is a cloud-native continuous integration and delivery
(CI/CD) solution for building pipelines using Tekton. Tekton is a flexible
Kubernetes-native open-source CI/CD framework, which enables automating
deployments across multiple platforms (Kubernetes, serverless, VMs, etc.) by
abstracting away the underlying details.

OpenShift-Pipelines Consists of:

- OpenShift-Pipelines: v0.16.3
- OpenShift-Pipelines-Triggers: v0.8.1
- OpenShift-Pipelines-ClusterTasks: v0.16
- OpenShift-Pipelines-CLI: v0.13.0

## Features

* Standard CI/CD pipelines definition

* Build images with Kubernetes tools such as S2I, Buildah, Buildpacks, Kaniko,
etc.

* Deploy applications to multiple platforms such as Kubernetes, Serverless and
VMs

* Easy to extend and integrate with existing tools

* Scale pipelines on-demand

* Portable across any Kubernetes platform

* Designed for microservices and decentralized teams

* Integrated with OpenShift Developer Console
